sections.title: Legal opinions, process agent and tax
Conditions precedent for the benefit of the Lender

cps.title: Facility Agreement
cps.requirement: Signatures to collect: (1) Borrower, by an authorised signatory; (2) Lender, by an authorised signatory; (3) Guarantor, if a party. The document must agree with the final agreed form. Check every page for manuscript changes. The parties date the agreement at signing.

cps.title: Fee Letter (upfront / arrangement fee)
cps.requirement: Signatures to collect: (1) Borrower; (2) Lender. The letter states the fee amount and the payment date. Link: CP-B05.

cps.title: Parent Guarantee [if applicable]
cps.requirement: Form: placeholder - add when received. If the structure includes a guarantee, collect the signature of the Guarantor and the countersignature of the Lender. A guarantee is credit support. It is not security over the aircraft.

cps.title: Subordination Agreement for shareholder loans [if applicable]
cps.requirement: Form: placeholder - add when received. Signatures to collect: (1) Borrower; (2) each shareholder creditor; (3) Lender. Use this if the term sheet requires subordination of intra-group debt.

cps.title: Utilisation Request
cps.requirement: Signed by an authorised signatory of the Borrower in the form in the schedule to the Facility Agreement. It states the amount, the Utilisation Date, the Interest Period and the account for payment. It repeats the representations and confirms that no Default continues. Link: G-01.

cps.title: Process agent appointment and acceptance letter
cps.requirement: Signatures to collect: (1) Borrower (appointment); (2) process agent in England (acceptance). Needed if the Borrower has no place of business in England. Link: CP-D04.

cps.title: Funds flow memorandum and payment instructions
cps.requirement: Signatures to collect: (1) Borrower; (2) Lender. The memorandum shows the amount, the value date, the receiving account and the deduction of fees, if any. The Lender verifies the account details by call-back. Link: CP-B06.

cps.title: KYC and AML documents
cps.requirement: The Borrower (and each Guarantor) gives all documents that the Lender requests for its KYC and AML checks. This includes the ownership chart to the ultimate beneficial owners, identity documents of directors and UBOs, and source of funds information. The Lender confirms in writing that its checks are complete.

cps.title: Sanctions screening of Borrower group, lessees and fleet
cps.requirement: The Lender screens the Borrower group, each lessee and each aircraft (by MSN and current location) against applicable sanctions lists. The Borrower confirms in writing that no aircraft is leased to, operated by or located in a sanctioned person or territory. The Lender records the result.

cps.title: Original financial statements
cps.requirement: Audited consolidated financial statements of the Borrower (and Guarantor) for the last [2] financial years. Unaudited management accounts for the latest quarter. Auditor's report must be unqualified, or the Lender must accept the qualification in writing.

cps.title: Fleet schedule and lease summary
cps.requirement: A schedule of every aircraft and engine owned or leased in by the Borrower group. For each asset: type, MSN, year of manufacture, owning entity, lessee, lessee jurisdiction, lease expiry, monthly rent, and existing financing or security. Mark each asset in the unencumbered pool. The Borrower certifies the schedule as true and complete.

cps.title: Payment of fees and expenses
cps.requirement: The Borrower pays the upfront fee in the Fee Letter and the agreed legal fees, or the funds flow shows deduction from the first utilisation. Evidence: payment confirmation or signed funds flow. Link: TD-02, TD-07.

cps.title: Borrower account details verified
cps.requirement: The Borrower gives the receiving account details on letterhead, signed by an authorised signatory. The Lender verifies the details by telephone call-back to a known contact. Do not accept changes by email only.

cps.title: Existing indebtedness schedule
cps.requirement: A schedule of all existing financial indebtedness, guarantees and security of the Borrower group, with lender, amount, maturity and secured assets. This sets the baseline for the negative pledge and permitted security. Link: CP-C05.

cps.title: Constitutional documents
cps.requirement: Copies of the certificate of incorporation, any change of name certificate, and the current constitution of the Borrower (and Guarantor). A director or company secretary certifies each copy as true, complete and in force.

cps.title: Board resolutions
cps.requirement: Resolutions of the board of the Borrower (and Guarantor) that approve the terms of the Finance Documents, authorise named persons to sign them and to sign each Utilisation Request and notice. Check quorum and director conflict declarations against the constitution.

cps.title: Shareholder resolution [if required]
cps.requirement: Form: placeholder - add when received. Needed if the constitution or local law requires shareholder approval, or for a guarantee where corporate benefit needs support.

cps.title: Officer's certificate
cps.requirement: A certificate signed by a director of the Borrower (and Guarantor). It attaches CP-C01 to CP-C03, gives specimen signatures of each authorised signatory, and confirms that the borrowing (and any guarantee) does not exceed any limit. It is dated not earlier than [5] Business Days before signing.

cps.title: Consents from existing financiers and authorities
cps.requirement: Copies of each consent, waiver or approval needed for the new loan. This includes consents under existing facilities with debt incurrence or negative pledge limits, and any regulatory or exchange control approval. If no consent is necessary, the Borrower confirms this in the officer's certificate.

cps.title: English law legal opinion
cps.requirement: A legal opinion from the Lender's English counsel on the validity, binding effect and enforceability of the Finance Documents. Addressed to the Lender. Draft agreed before signing. Signed form at or before utilisation.

cps.title: Capacity opinion: Borrower jurisdiction ([TO CONFIRM])
cps.requirement: A legal opinion from counsel in the Borrower's jurisdiction of incorporation (for example Ireland, Singapore or Cayman Islands) on capacity, due authorisation, execution, no conflict, choice of English law, recognition of English judgments, and no filing or stamp duty.

cps.title: Capacity opinion: Guarantor jurisdiction [if applicable]
cps.requirement: Form: placeholder - add when received. Same scope as CP-D02 for the Guarantor. Include corporate benefit and financial assistance points.

cps.title: Process agent acceptance
cps.requirement: Evidence that the process agent in England accepts its appointment for the Borrower (and Guarantor). Link: TD-06.

cps.title: Withholding tax position
cps.requirement: Written tax analysis or confirmation that interest payments to the Lender are free of withholding tax, or that a treaty or exemption applies. If an exemption needs a filing or form, the Lender receives evidence of the filing.
cps.deliverer: Borrower's tax adviser (evidence: tax memo or filing)

cps.title: No Default and repeating representations
cps.requirement: On the date of the Utilisation Request and on the Utilisation Date, no Default continues or results from the loan, and the repeating representations are true in all material respects. Evidence: the Utilisation Request (TD-05) and the officer's confirmation.

cps.title: Pro forma compliance certificate
cps.requirement: A certificate signed by the CFO that shows pro forma compliance with each financial covenant after the loan: [leverage ratio], [interest cover], [minimum liquidity], [unencumbered asset ratio]. Calculations must use CP-B03 and CP-B04.

cps.title: Appraisals of the unencumbered pool
cps.requirement: Desktop appraisals of each aircraft in the unencumbered pool from [two / three] ISTAT-certified appraisers, dated not earlier than [90] days before the Utilisation Date. The covenant uses the [average / lower] of the half-life base values.

cps.title: International Registry and local registry searches
cps.requirement: Priority search certificates from the International Registry (Cape Town Convention) for each airframe and engine in the unencumbered pool. Searches of each national aircraft register where relevant. Each result must show no registered international interest or security other than permitted items.

cps.title: Corporate searches and insolvency checks
cps.requirement: Company registry searches and winding-up searches on the Borrower (and Guarantor) in the jurisdiction of incorporation. The result must show no insolvency filing, charge or strike-off action. Repeat on the Utilisation Date.

cps.title: No material adverse change
cps.requirement: No event or circumstance occurs that has a Material Adverse Effect, as defined in the Facility Agreement. The Lender confirms this in writing before it releases funds.

cps.title: Fleet insurance summary [if required]
cps.requirement: Form: placeholder - add when received. A broker's letter that summarises hull and liability insurances of the fleet and confirms that premiums are paid. Most unsecured facilities do not require this. Keep the row only if the term sheet asks for it.

cps.title: Delivery of Utilisation Request
cps.requirement: The Lender receives the signed Utilisation Request not later than [11:00 a.m. London time] [3] Business Days before the proposed Utilisation Date. Link: TD-05.

cps.title: CP satisfaction notice
cps.requirement: The Lender's counsel confirms in writing to the Lender that every CP in Sections A to E is satisfied or waived. Only a human gate records each item. The Lender then notifies the Borrower.

cps.title: Release of funds
cps.requirement: The Lender pays the loan to the verified account in CP-B06, in the amount and on the date in the funds flow (TD-07). The Lender keeps the payment confirmation (MT103 or equal).

cps.title: Original signed documents
cps.requirement: The Borrower couriers the original wet-ink documents (if any) to the Lender's counsel within [10] Business Days after signing. If the parties sign electronically, confirm that each signature method is valid under the law of each signatory's jurisdiction.

cps.title: Signed legal opinions (if draft at closing)
cps.requirement: If any opinion is in agreed draft form at closing, the signed opinion goes to the Lender within [5] Business Days after the Utilisation Date.

cps.title: Updated fleet schedule and first compliance certificate
cps.requirement: The Borrower gives an updated fleet schedule within [30] days after the Utilisation Date and the first periodic compliance certificate on the first test date. Diary both dates.
cps.timing: [30] days after Utilisation Date / first test date

cps.title: Subordination of intra-group debt [if applicable]
cps.requirement: Form: placeholder - add when received. If not signed at closing, the Borrower delivers the signed Subordination Agreement within [30] days. Link: TD-04.
